description:
Revolutionizing the world With an easy access, visualization and understanding of the 
the blockchain, through an agnostic wallet and user-friendly interface with strong safety.
Why ?
Because for many people, access to the crypto economy remains complex.
There is significant doubt for each action, as security and interoperability Is not always guaranteed.
how_its_made:
We use generative AI to understand the need of the user and to provide him the blockchain service or action that he need.
The app is mostly a react.js front, that interact directly with the blockchain and data api. And a back that do only language processing.
We use an interactive graph to display information and to be able to drag and drop element between wallet and blockchain.
